HomePage.faq1Q: What is an Instagram Story Viewer?
HomePage.faq1A: It's a tool that looks up a public Instagram account's profile information (photo, name, bio, follower counts) by fetching the same public profile page anyone's browser would see, without you needing to log in.
HomePage.faq2Q: Can I view public Instagram Stories without logging in?
HomePage.faq2A: No, and neither can this tool. Instagram only serves Story media through a logged-in session, even for public accounts; it's never exposed on the public, unauthenticated profile page. This tool doesn't attempt to bypass that, so it never returns Story content, only public profile information.
HomePage.faq3Q: Why can't some Stories be retrieved?
HomePage.faq3A: Stories aren't sometimes unavailable: they're never retrievable through public, unauthenticated access, on any account. Unlike a profile's basic info, Instagram doesn't expose Story media outside of a logged-in session. This isn't a bug or a temporary limitation; it's how Instagram's access control works.
HomePage.faq4Q: Does this tool work with private accounts?
HomePage.faq4A: No. It only works with public profiles. Private accounts require the owner's approval inside Instagram itself, and this tool never attempts to bypass that.
HomePage.faq5Q: How does this tool retrieve profile information?
HomePage.faq5A: By fetching a public account's Instagram profile page the same way any anonymous, logged-out visitor's browser would, then reading the public information Instagram includes in that page: no login, no private API, no bypass of any access control.
HomePage.finalCtaTitle: Ready to look up a profile?
HomePage.finalCtaText: Enter a public Instagram username and see their profile instantly, no login required.

AboutPage.metaDescription: Learn what {siteName} does, how it works, and why it only ever shows public Instagram profile data, never Story media.
AboutPage.intro: {siteName} is a single-purpose tool: enter a public Instagram username, and see their public profile information (photo, name, bio, follower counts) without needing to log into Instagram yourself.
AboutPage.whatWeDoText: We fetch a public account's Instagram profile page the same way any anonymous, logged-out browser would, then display the public information Instagram includes in that page. Story media specifically is never part of that: Instagram only serves Story content through a logged-in session, on every account, so no tool that respects Instagram's access controls, including this one, can show it. That's the whole product: no feed browsing, no messaging, no account management.

DisclaimerPage.metaDescription: Important information about what {siteName} can and cannot do.
DisclaimerPage.publicOnlyText: {siteName} only retrieves and displays content from public Instagram profiles. We cannot and do not access private accounts, direct messages, or any content behind Instagram's login wall.
DisclaimerPage.noPasswordText: We will never ask for your Instagram password. Any website that requests your Instagram login credentials to "view stories" should be treated as untrustworthy. {siteName} never does this.
DisclaimerPage.anonymityText: "Anonymous" on this site means your personal Instagram account is not used to open a Story, so it isn't added to the account owner's native viewer list. It does not mean guaranteed technical anonymity in every sense: we rely on third-party infrastructure to retrieve data, and we can't make guarantees about systems outside our control.
DisclaimerPage.affiliationText: {siteName} is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Instagram or Meta Platforms, Inc. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
DisclaimerPage.availabilityText: Story availability depends on what the account owner has currently posted and on our data provider's ability to retrieve it. We cannot guarantee that every public account's Stories will always be retrievable.

PrivacyPolicyPage.metaDescription: How {siteName} handles data when you search for and view public Instagram Stories.
PrivacyPolicyPage.overviewText: {siteName} ("we", "us") provides a tool to view publicly available Instagram Stories by username. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how it's handled.
PrivacyPolicyPage.collectUsernamesText: The Instagram username you enter is sent to our server to look up public Story data. We do not require or collect your own Instagram credentials. Never enter your Instagram password on this site.
PrivacyPolicyPage.collectTechnicalText: Standard request metadata (such as IP address and user agent) is processed transiently for rate limiting, abuse prevention, and basic error logging.
PrivacyPolicyPage.collectAnalyticsText: We may use privacy-conscious, aggregated analytics (e.g. page views, device type, and anonymized event counts such as "search succeeded" or "no stories found") to understand tool usage. We do not sell personal data.
PrivacyPolicyPage.dontItem1: We never ask for your Instagram password or login credentials.
PrivacyPolicyPage.dontItem2: We don't require account creation to use the tool.
PrivacyPolicyPage.dontItem3: We don't sell personal data to third parties.
PrivacyPolicyPage.cookiesText: We use only the minimum cookies or local storage needed for the site to function and, where enabled, privacy-conscious analytics. We don't use cookies to build advertising profiles of individual users.
PrivacyPolicyPage.thirdPartyText: To retrieve public Story data, requests may be routed to a third-party data provider. We only transmit the username you search, no personal account information about you.
PrivacyPolicyPage.advertisingText: This site may display third-party advertising, including through Google AdSense. Ad providers may use cookies or similar technologies to serve relevant ads; you can manage ad personalization through <adsLink>Google Ads Settings</adsLink>.
PrivacyPolicyPage.rightsText: You can contact us at any time to ask what data we hold about you or to request deletion of any data we can associate with you.
PrivacyPolicyPage.contactText: Questions about this policy? <email>email</email> or visit our <contactLink>Contact page</contactLink>.
